Name: Bread and Salt
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52553/52553-1789742581-557895723.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

Uses BETAS to add an extra +40 friendship when gifting a Cooked Foodstuff that an NPC already loves (e.g. Giving Sam a Pizza will result in +120 friendship). Does not affect liked gifts, and the bonus is not affected by Birthdays or Winter Star bonuses.

This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Small Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!

[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52553/52553-1789742581-1833138247.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[size=3]- Stardew Valley 1.6+[/size]
[size=3]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url][/size]

[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52553/52553-1789742578-589055205.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][size=3]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Bread and Salt[/b] to your mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/size][/*]
[/list]
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52553/52553-1789742573-2075914932.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]
